spans.s:
गोप॑ m. cow-keeper, cowherd (f. ई), keeper or guardian
i.g., E. of Kṛṣṇa.

गोपथ m. way for cows;
 T. of a Brāhmaṇa.

गो॑पन n. guarding, protecting (also नोपना॑ f.);
hiding, concealment.
गोपनीय a. to be guarded from (abl.).

गोपय् गोप˚यति & गोप˚यते pp. गोपित guard,
preserve, hide, keep secret.

गोपाय् गोपा˚य॑ति & गोपा˚यते guard, protect, keep
secret. —अभि & परि A. guard, shelter.

गोपालक m. cowherd (f. ˚लिका);
 E. of Kṛṣṇa.
गोपालदारक m. a cowherd's boy, a young cowherd.*
गोपा॑वन्त् a. granting protection.
गो॑पिष्ठ (superl.) protecting best.
1 गोपीथ॑ m. a draught of milk.
2 गोपीथ॑ m. protection, shelter.

गोपुच्छ n. cow's tail;
 m. a kind of monkey.
गोपुर n. town-gate, gate i.g.
गोपेन्द्र m. chief herdsman, E. of Kṛṣṇa.
गोपेश m. chief herdsman, E. of Kṛṣṇa.

गोप्तृ॑ m. guardian, protector (f. गोप्त्री॑, n. गोप्तृ);
who hides or conceals.
